site.name: American Metals Incline
site.componentDetail: Named historic mine incline shown on Copper Mountain topographic mapping
overview: American Metals Incline is a named historic mine feature in Summit County in the high country near Jacque Peak and Copper Mountain. U.S. Geological Survey-derived topographic mapping places the mine locality at approximately 39.44832, -106.19530.
Remnant uses the mapped mine locality as an identification point. The record does not claim that a mine opening is currently accessible, open, or safe.
